title: Protocol for live-cell imaging during Tumor Treating Fields treatment with Inovitro Live
protocol: Place the Ibidi dish with cells and the sterile Inovitro LiveTM insert in a clean biological hood.
Place the Ibidi Glass cover on the Inovitro LiveTM insert.
Insert the Inovitro LiveTM insert onto the Ibidi dish.
Press down firmly until the insert reaches the bottom.
Make sure that silicone tubing is in place for medium replacement.
Make sure that cooling coil is in place.
Transfer the Ibidi dish with insert horizontally and place it on the microscope stage.
Fix it to the stage firmly using a designated connector or glue pads.
Connect the Inovitro LiveTM cable to the insert.
Place the cover heating element over the Inovitro LiveTM insert.
Connect CO2 gas supply to the microscope chamber.
Switch on the generator and laptop.
Open the Inovitro LiveTM software.
Create a new experiment by pressing the ‘New Experiment’ button in the Inovitro LiveTM software.
Disable the “configure session” option when creating a new experiment.
Set the desired parameters correctly for the experiment, including frequency and medium target temperature settings.
Set heating element temperature between 37°C and 55°C.
Set duty cycle A or B to '0' for single pair of electrodes TTFields application.
Press ‘Change Default’ button to adjust alarm thresholds.
Log graphs can be requested by pressing the ‘reports’ button during experiment.
Start TTF treatment using Inovitro LiveTM software according to experimental setup.
For stage top incubator cooling, set temperature ranging from 18°C-32°C.
For cooling coil, start peristaltic pump at lowest speed and stabilize medium temperature.
Gradually increase pump speed until desired current is reached for cooling coil.
Position the dish with cells at the region-of-interest.
Select the desired microscope settings (channels, exposure times etc.) using the microscope software.
Follow the experiment for 20–30 min until the medium temperature has stabilized.
Adjust the focus of the microscope as necessary due to temperature changes.
Press the stop experiment button in the software when ending the experiment.
Allow time for all data to be transferred from the generator to the laptop/computer.
Turn off the generator and disconnect all cables from the insert.
Remove the Inovitro liveTM insert from the dish by pulling vertically.
Rinse the insert thoroughly with distilled water.
Let the insert dry.
Sterilize the insert in an autoclave before the next experiment.
Connect a sterile 5 mL syringe to the silicone tubing when replacing medium.
Pause the experiment by clicking the pause button in the software.
Remove the medium using the syringe.
Carefully inject 3 mL of new medium with a new, sterile syringe.
